name: How long does it take to install easy grip door hardware on multiple doors?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install easy grip door hardware on multiple doors?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time required for installation depends on the number of doors, the existing door types, and the complexity of the hardware chosen. A typical residential installation of easy grip hardware on several interior doors can often be completed within a single day. Exterior doors or those requiring frame modifications might take longer. We aim to complete projects efficiently with minimal disruption to your daily routine, providing a clear timeline during the initial consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installing easy grip hardware on multiple interior doors usually takes one day. Exterior doors or complex installations may take longer, with a timeline provided during consultation.
